name: pr-reviewer
description: Convenience scripts for the server/ and web/ packages. No dependencies live here.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix web test
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.clean: node -e "for (const d of ['server/node_modules','server/dist','web/node_modules','web/dist']) require('fs').rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })"
